skill.name: improving-components
skill.description: Applies structured improvements to Claude Code components using quality analysis results. It refines descriptions, tool permissions, security notes, documentation, and examples while preserving component intent.
skill.summary: Improves Claude Code component descriptions, permissions, documentation, and security posture from quality review findings.
skill.author: C0ntr0lledCha0s

security_audit.summary: All 65 static findings were adjudicated as false positives. The hits are Markdown fences, inline examples, or checklist text in SKILL.md, and the package contains only SKILL.md with Read and Edit permissions. No prompt injection, exfiltration intent, or executable payload evidence was found.

content.value_statement: Claude Code components often lose quality through vague descriptions, broad permissions, or thin examples. This skill turns review findings into focused edits that improve clarity, safety, and usability.
actual_capabilities: Improves descriptions for skills, agents, commands, and hooks.
Recommends minimal tool permissions based on component purpose.
Adds or improves usage examples, capabilities, and documentation structure.
Prioritizes security, schema, and functionality issues before style changes.
Preserves component intent while applying incremental edits.
Summarizes before and after quality changes for review.
limitations: Works best when a quality analysis report or clear review notes are available.
Focuses on Claude Code components, not general application source code.
Uses Read and Edit permissions only, so it cannot run validation commands itself.
References helper scripts and templates, but this package includes only SKILL.md.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Skill for Review
use_cases.description: Improve a skill description, trigger guidance, permissions, and examples before marketplace submission.

use_cases.title: Reduce Component Permissions
use_cases.description: Review broad tool access and convert it to the smallest permission set that still supports the component.

use_cases.title: Standardize Component Documentation
use_cases.description: Apply a consistent structure with capabilities, usage guidance, examples, and remaining recommendations.

prompt_templates.title: Improve a Basic Skill
prompt_templates.prompt: Improve this Claude Code skill using the quality findings I provide. Keep the original purpose, strengthen the description, and explain each change.

prompt_templates.title: Tighten Tool Permissions
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this component tool list and propose the minimum permissions needed. Apply safe edits and document why each removed tool was unnecessary.

prompt_templates.title: Add Marketplace-Ready Documentation
prompt_templates.prompt: Upgrade this component for marketplace review. Add clear capabilities, activation triggers, examples, limitations, and a concise before and after summary.

prompt_templates.title: Apply Full Quality Remediation
prompt_templates.prompt: Use these quality analysis results to remediate critical, important, and optional issues in order. Make incremental edits and preserve existing behavior.

output_examples.input: A skill has a vague description and too many allowed tools.
output_examples.output: The result is a clearer description, a smaller permission list, and notes explaining why removed tools were not required.

output_examples.input: A component lacks examples and activation guidance.
output_examples.output: The result is a structured documentation update with concrete triggers, use cases, and example interactions.

output_examples.input: A quality review lists security, usability, and style findings.
output_examples.output: The result is an ordered remediation summary that handles security first, then usability, then optional polish.

best_practices: Provide the original component and the quality findings before asking for edits.
Review permission changes carefully when a component previously used Bash, Write, or network tools.
Validate the edited component with your normal marketplace or repository checks.
anti_patterns: Do not use this skill to change a component purpose during a quality pass.
Do not keep broad tool permissions only because they were already present.
Do not apply optional style changes before resolving security or schema issues.

faq.question: What does this skill improve?
faq.answer: It improves Claude Code component descriptions, permissions, documentation, examples, and security guidance.

faq.question: Does it need another skill first?
faq.answer: It works best with quality findings from an analysis skill, but a user can also provide review notes.

faq.question: Can it run validation commands?
faq.answer: No. The skill declares Read and Edit permissions only, so command execution must be handled outside the skill.

faq.question: Can it improve agents and commands?
faq.answer: Yes. The guidance covers skills, agents, commands, and hooks.

faq.question: Will it rewrite component behavior?
faq.answer: No. Its stated approach is to preserve the component purpose and existing usage patterns.

faq.question: Is it suitable for marketplace preparation?
faq.answer: Yes. It focuses on clearer descriptions, safer permissions, better examples, and review-ready summaries.
